messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
On which date was the EC declaration of conformity drawn up for the complete robot cell, meaning the final machine in which the UR5e and UR10e arms are integrated?

response.text: Per quale data è stata redatta la dichiarazione di conformità CE per la cella robotizzata completa, cioè la macchina finale in cui sono integrati i bracci UR5e e UR10e?
